source: Model Tenancy Act, 2021 (national model law; states adopt and modify it). Verify against the Act text before relying on it.

rules.title: Deposit cap
rules.benchmark: Security deposit for a residential home should be at most 2 months' rent.
rules.flag: Deposit above 2 months' rent is against the model law.

rules.title: Deposit refund
rules.benchmark: The deposit is refunded when the tenant hands back the home, after only lawful, itemised deductions.
rules.flag: No refund clause, or refund at the landlord's sole discretion, is unusual.

rules.title: Rent revision notice
rules.benchmark: Rent can be revised only as agreed, with written notice 3 months before the new rent applies.
rules.flag: Rent increase allowed at any time or without notice is against the model law.

rules.title: No eviction at will
rules.benchmark: A tenant can be evicted during the tenancy only through the Rent Authority or Rent Court, on listed grounds.
rules.flag: Landlord may evict at will or on short notice: against the model law.

rules.title: Essential services
rules.benchmark: A landlord may not cut off water, electricity or other essential supplies to the home.
rules.flag: A clause allowing supplies to be cut is against the model law.

rules.title: Landlord entry
rules.benchmark: The landlord enters only after at least 24 hours' written notice, at reasonable hours.
rules.flag: Entry at any time without notice is unusual.

rules.title: Repairs split
rules.benchmark: Structural repairs are the landlord's job; small day-to-day repairs are the tenant's.
rules.flag: Tenant paying for all repairs, including structural ones, is unusual.

rules.title: Lock-in and penalty
rules.benchmark: Common practice: lock-in of 6 months or less, early-exit penalty of at most 1 month's rent.
rules.flag: Lock-in over 6 months or a penalty above 1 month's rent is unusual.
